name: Vision Player Pro
summary:
Your movies. Your screen. Any size you want.

Vision Player Pro turns your Quest into the best seat in the house — a floating cinema screen in your room, or full 180°/360° immersion. Play videos stored on your headset, or stream straight from any Mac, PC, or NAS on your Wi-Fi. No companion app, no conversion, no setup.

STREAM FROM ANY COMPUTER
Turn on the file sharing built into macOS, Windows, or your NAS, and your computer appears automatically. Log in once, browse your drives — including external SSDs —
